Decision cutoff: 2023-03-28T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Introducing Microsoft Security Copilot: Empowering defenders at the speed of AI. Published date: 2023-03-28. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2023/03/28/introducing-microsoft-security-copilot-empowering-defenders-at-the-speed-of-ai.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: The odds are against today’s defenders Today the odds remain stacked against cybersecurity professionals. Compounding this challenge is a global shortage of skilled security professionals, leading to an estimated 3.4 million openings in the field. Security Copilot — end-to-end defense at machine speed and scale Microsoft Security Copilot is the first security product to enable defenders to move at the speed and scale of AI. Security Copilot also integrates with the end-to-end Microsoft Security products, and over time it will expand to a growing ecosystem of third-party products. Editor’s note, April 12, 2024: Microsoft Copilot for Security with new capabilities is now available worldwide.
